content: YouTuber Mark “Markiplier” Fischbach has invested enough in GoPro to become its single largest shareholder, with an 8.5 percent stake in the company, Bloomberg reports. Speaking to Bloomberg, Fischbach said he thought GoPro “seems undervalued” and sees his investment as “part of a larger mission to make filmmaking more accessible,” following the release of his first feature film, Iron Lung, earlier this year.  Fischbach posted a video last week praising GoPro’s new Mission 1 ILS camera and comparing it to the pricier Red Komodo-X, saying he plans to use the Mission 1 ILS in future movies. It includes an affiliate code for the new camera, but we didn’t spot any mention of his involvement in the company in the caption or the video itself. [Media: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8flNsaufwKk] Fellow YouTuber Marques Brownlee commented on the news of Fischbach’s investment in a post on Threads with a still from the video, saying, “This is not a line I see crossed very often, but to each their own.”  GoPro did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

chineseContent: 据彭博社报道，YouTuber Mark “Markiplier” Fischbach 已对 GoPro 进行了足够的投资，成为其单一最大股东，持有该公司 8.5% 的股份。菲施巴赫在接受彭博社采访时表示，他认为 GoPro“似乎被低估了”，并认为自己的投资是“让电影制作变得更容易实现的更大使命的一部分”，继今年早些时候上映了他的第一部故事片《铁肺》之后。  Fischbach 上周发布了一段视频，赞扬 GoPro 的新款 Mission 1 ILS 摄像机，并将其与价格更高的 Red Komodo-X 进行比较，并表示他计划在未来的电影中使用 Mission 1 ILS。它包含新相机的附属代码，但我们在标题或视频本身中没有发现他参与该公司的任何提及。 [媒体：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8flNsaufwKk] YouTuber Marques Brownlee 在 Threads 上的一篇帖子中用视频截图评论了 Fischbach 投资的消息，他说：“这不是我经常看到的跨越的界限，而是每个人自己的界限。”  GoPro 没有立即回应置评请求。
